currentRoundInspection.scope: Madrid’s Forest of Remembrance memorial mound with its north causeway, rising spiral, summit loop, granite-lined crescent channel, three timber bridges and fluted entrance column. The 170 cypresses and 22 olives follow the original planting inventory, with recorded tree points and inferred infill.
